create_LaserLstmEncoder: create a LaserLstmEncoder instance with embedding size, hidden size, and number of LSTM layers
build_sentence_embedding: build sentence embeddings by passing token sequences and their lengths through the encoder
sort_sequences_by_length: sort sequences and lengths in descending order while tracking original indices
configure_bidirectional_encoder: configure a bidirectional LaserLstmEncoder to double output units and process sequences in both directions
max_pool_encoder_outputs: max-pool over padded LSTM outputs to produce fixed-size sentence embeddings
